Analyst, Risk ManagementJob Description:

* Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills.

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We’re looking for a Senior Accounting Analyst, Mortgage to join our Mortgage Accounting team. In this role, you’ll own core day-to-day accounting for One Real Mortgage, from journal entries and reconciliations through accounts payable, broker check processing, and expense bill-backs, so the business closes on time with accurate, well-supported books. * Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and core accounting concepts, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany activity.
* Hands-on experience with an ERP or general ledger system (e.g., NetSuite or similar) and proficiency in Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation workbooks.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to trace transactions to support and resolve discrepancies independently.
* Strong organization and time management skills to meet month-end close deadlines while handling recurring AP and payment processing.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort partnering with mortgage operations, AP, and finance stakeholders to follow up on open items.
* Familiarity with mortgage lending operations or financial services accounting is a plus.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 6+ years of accounting experience, ideally including month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, and accounts payable; mortgage, lending, or financial services experience preferred.
* CA or progress toward CA is a plus but not required.

title: Manager - Finance
description:
### **We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Manager professional to join our team. The role involves managing month-end closing, audits, taxation, and comprehensive accounting operations while ensuring accurate reporting and timely compliance. You will also collaborate closely with internal teams to drive financial discipline, oversee reconciliations, and support critical business reporting. If you excel in a dynamic environment and are committed to maintaining high standards of financial integrity, we'd love to connect.** **What You'll Do:**

#### **1. Financial Accounting & Period-End Closure:**

* **Month-End & Year-End Close:** Lead and streamline the monthly and annual book-close processes for the multiple business line in accordance with established timelines.
* **D2C & E-Commerce Accounting:** Spearheaded end-to-end accounting for the goods business vertical, including inventory valuation, revenue and procurement recognition, and SKU-level gross margin analysis across multiple e-commerce platforms.
* **P&L & Balance Sheet Review:** Conduct thorough P&L reviews and quarterly Balance Sheet reconciliations, providing clear variance analysis and business justifications for cost fluctuations.
* **Provisions & Accruals:** Track, record, and periodically review provisions, unbilled revenues, and accrual aging schedules for timely adjustments or releases.

#### **2. Audits, Governance & Statutory Compliance:**

* **Statutory & Entity Audits:** Spearhead internal and external audits for legal entities (UAE, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), ensuring timely resolution of audit queries and sign-off well within management deadlines.
* **Direct Tax Audits & Assessments:** Coordinate and close Tax Audits, Transfer Pricing audits, and regulatory filings (including COI/statutory disclosures).
* **Tax Assessment Support:** Facilitate Income Tax and Transfer Pricing assessments by preparing schedules, documentation, and liaison with external tax consultants.

#### **3. Taxation (Direct & Indirect):**

* **TDS Compliance:** Ensure accurate deduction and accounting of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) based on the applicable sections and nature of vendor contracts.
* **GST & ITC Reconciliation:** Manage GST compliance, maximise Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilisation strictly adhering to statutory rules, and maintain monthly GSTR-2B/3B reconciliations.

#### **4. Working Capital & Operational Finance:**

* **Accounts Payable (AP):** Oversee invoice verification, coding, and accurate, timely disbursement processing.
* **Accounts Receivable (AR) & Credit Control:** Monitor customer aging reports, ensure proactive follow-up for collections, and maintain strict adherence to agreed credit periods.
* **Reconciliations:** Perform regular vendor, client, and inter-company ledger reconciliations to minimise unadjusted balances.

#### **5. Management Reporting & Strategic Projects:**

* **MIS & Management Reporting:** Prepare and present routine management packs, including Sales & Cost analysis, AP/AR ageing summaries, and working capital overviews.
* **Cross-Functional Projects:** Partner with cross-functional teams on process improvement, ERP enhancements, and ad-hoc accounting projects.

**6. Executive Support:** Support the Head of Department (HOD) and senior leadership with ad-hoc analytical assignments and special initiatives.

  

### **Who You Are:**

  

**1.** **Education:** MBA , Semi-qualified CA or ACCA preferred.

**2. Experience:** Min 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in financial reporting, corporate taxation (TDS/GST), and audit management.

**3. Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP / Oracle / NetSuite / Tally) and advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modelling, pivot tables, lookup formulas).

**4. Core Competencies:** High attention to detail, strong analytical capability, proactive stakeholder communication, and strict adherence to statutory deadlines.

**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Credit Risk Review (CRR)**
==================================


**Credit Risk Review** (CRR) provides independent, objective, reliable, valued, and timely assurance to the Board of Directors, Risk Committees, the Citigroup Chief Risk Officer, the Citigroup Chief Credit Officer, senior management, and global regulators. CRR evaluates the effectiveness of credit and collateral risk management, assessing the ability of business units and independent Risk Management to identify, monitor, and mitigate current and emerging credit risks.


**Role Overview**
=================


As a key member of the **CRR Analytics Team**, you will provide critical data analytics and credit risk analyst support to Lead Reviewers. This role is instrumental in managing ongoing portfolio monitoring and credit reviews, identifying thematic risk trends, and evaluating emerging risks. You will collaborate closely with reviewers to assign portfolios, establish sample coverages, and participate actively in review activities, while also supporting broader data\-driven credit risk projects across the CRR group.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


* **Credit \& Exposure Assessment**: Evaluate the integrity and accuracy of credit analyses, exposure calculations, risk rating methodologies, and asset classifications for monitored and reviewed relationships to ensure alignment with institutional policies and standards.
* **Credit Assessment Documentation**: Partner with Lead Reviewers to draft comprehensive Credit Assessment Documents, integrating advanced credit and data analytics to quantify thematic risks or substantiate a portfolio's stable outlook ("good bill of health").
* **Assistant to the Lead Reviewer:** Serve as a strategic analytical partner to Lead Reviewers, translating qualitative observations and risk hypotheses into rigorous, data\-backed evidence. Maintain a deep understanding of credit policies and data structures to track the end\-to\-end credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting standards, limit utilization, covenant compliance, and workout/remediation processes.
* **AI \& Analytics Innovation**: Leverage advanced AI and machine learning tools to streamline data extraction, identify thematic trends across diverse portfolios, and proactively flag emerging risk indicators.
* **Stakeholder Communication**: Synthesize complex analytical findings and present clear, concise conclusions and recommendations to Lead Reviewers and senior risk management.
* **Reporting \& Regulatory Presentations:** Assist in preparing high\-quality presentations and reporting materials to support internal governance committees and regulatory examinations.

**Qualifications**
==================


* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of credit analysis or credit risk management experience within a global financial institution or banking environment.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Formal credit training or a deep understanding of financial accounting standards and credit analysis methodologies.
* **Corporate/FI Analysis:** Prior experience assessing the creditworthiness and financial strength of Corporates and Financial Institutions is highly advantageous.
* **Digital Literacy:** High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and a strong aptitude for adopting AI\-enabled productivity and data analytics tools in compliance with organizational policies. Knowledge of Python is highly advantageous.

* **Execution Skills:** Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple deliverables.
* **Communication:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex risk concepts clearly and concisely to various levels of management.

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BSc) in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
